title: E-Commerce Refund, Escrow & Card Chargeback Law in Bangladesh: Recovery Guide
metaTitle: E-Commerce Refund, Escrow & Chargeback Law Bangladesh
metaDescription: Legal remedies for prepaid online shopping scams, delayed e-commerce refunds, Bangladesh Bank escrow rules, Visa/Mastercard chargeback & DNCRP claims in BD.
heroIntro: Prepaid e-commerce non-delivery, fake product substitutions, and indefinite refund holds have become major commercial hazards for online shoppers and diaspora buyers ordering gifts in Bangladesh. Between the Digital Commerce Operation Guidelines 2021, Bangladesh Bank’s payment escrow circulars, Visa/Mastercard card chargeback rules, and statutory consumer and penal remedies, victims have structured legal pathways to freeze funds and recover money rapidly.

quickAnswer.heading: At a Glance: Online Shopping Refund & Chargeback Remedies
quickAnswer.text: Bangladesh enforces strict delivery and refund timelines under Digital Commerce Operation Guidelines 2021 and mandatory payment escrow protection. Prepaid goods must ship within 5 to 10 days, delayed orders require cash refunds within 7 to 10 working days, and cardholders can pursue bank chargebacks within 60 to 120 days.
points: Delivery Window (Guidelines 2021): Maximum 5 days within same city (10 days inter-district) after advance payment unless pre-disclosed
Mandatory Refund Window: Advance funds must be refunded within 7 to 10 working days if seller fails delivery deadlines
Bank Card Chargeback: File a formal "Goods/Services Not Received" dispute with issuing bank within 60–120 days of payment
Statutory Forums: DNCRP administrative claim, Police GD/FIR under Penal Code s.406/420, or Cyber Security framework

sections.h2: Digital Commerce Operation Guidelines 2021 & Mandatory DBID Rules
sections.content:
Issued by the Ministry of Commerce, the Digital Commerce Operation Guidelines 2021 bind e-commerce marketplaces, Facebook F-commerce pages, and online service portals operating in Bangladesh:

  • Handover & Delivery Cap: Sellers accepting advance payment must hand over ready stock to a delivery partner within 48 hours and complete delivery within 5 days (same city) or 10 days (outside city), unless a clear customized timeline was consented to before checkout.
  • Strict Refund Deadline: If the seller cancels or misses the delivery deadline, all advance money must be refunded to the buyer’s exact payment channel within 7 to 10 working days—merchants cannot compel buyers to accept wallet credits instead of money.
  • DBID Registration: Commercial Facebook pages and e-stores must hold a Digital Business Identification (DBID) from RJSC and clearly display physical address, TIN, and customer grievance contacts. Before paying large commercial deposits, verify the entity via business trade license compliance checks.

sections.h2: How Bangladesh Bank Escrow Protects Prepaid Online Buyers
sections.content:
To stop platforms from collecting millions in advance payments and disappearing, Bangladesh Bank’s Payment Systems Department introduced mandatory escrow settlement for marketplace transactions paid via payment gateways, cards, or MFS:

Under this mechanism, when you pay an online marketplace through an authorized PSO/PSP gateway (such as SSLCommerz, aamarPay, bKash Merchant, or Nagad), the gateway retains the customer’s funds in a controlled escrow account and releases settlement to the merchant only after verified proof of delivery or customer confirmation. If you never received the product, lodging an immediate dispute ticket with the payment gateway and issuing bank before escrow payout freezes the merchant’s settlement immediately and preserves evidence if BFIU or bank freeze inquiries arise.

sections.h2: Using Debit/Credit Card Chargeback to Reverse Fraudulent E-Commerce Charges
sections.content:
Buyers who paid using a local or international Visa, Mastercard, or UnionPay debit/credit card have a high-recovery remedy that requires no initial lawyer fees—the Card Chargeback:

  1. Preserve Evidence Immediately: Screenshot the invoice, order confirmation email, seller WhatsApp or Messenger promises, and failed tracking logs.
  2. Submit Bank Dispute Form: Contact your card-issuing bank’s Card Division (in Bangladesh or abroad for NRBs) and submit a formal Chargeback / Dispute Form citing Reason Code: Goods or Services Not Received / Not as Described.
  3. Strict Time Window: Card network chargeback cycles normally allow 60 to 120 calendar days from transaction date or promised delivery date. Once your bank initiates chargeback, the acquiring bank debits the merchant unless the merchant produces signed courier proof of valid delivery.

sections.h2: Filing DNCRP Consumer Complaints & Criminal Cheating Cases
sections.content:
Where payment was made via direct bank transfer or P2P mobile money to a rogue seller, escalate simultaneously on three fronts:

  • DNCRP Administrative Remedy: Under the Consumer Rights Protection Act, 2009, file a complaint within 30 days of the cause of action at dncrp.portal.gov.bd or the National Helpline 16121. DNCRP routinely compels full refunds and levies fines for non-delivery or defective goods.
  • Police Complaint & Criminal Action: If an organized online page takes money from multiple victims with zero intent to deliver, lodge a General Diary / FIR for criminal breach of trust and cheating (Sections 406/420 Penal Code) alongside bKash/Nagad MFS fraud tracing and Cyber Crime Unit reporting. Where multiple disputes reveal systematic fraud, filing a formal Police FIR initiates judicial recovery.

sections.h2: NRB Diaspora Checklist When Ordering Goods or Services in Bangladesh
sections.content: Non-Resident Bangladeshis in the US, UK, Canada, Europe, and the Middle East often buy electronics, furniture, or wedding gifts online for relatives in Dhaka. Protect yourself by verifying the merchant’s DBID and physical showroom, paying via an international credit card rather than direct F-commerce personal bKash transfers, keeping cash-on-delivery (COD) open-box inspection rights for local relatives, and filing immediate card chargebacks with your foreign bank if delivery stalls beyond the promised window.

faqs.q: Can an online store force me to take store credit instead of a refund?
faqs.a: No. Under the Digital Commerce Operation Guidelines 2021, whenever a seller fails to deliver prepaid goods within the prescribed 5 to 10 day window or delivers materially defective items, the buyer holds the legal right to a full monetary refund back to the original payment method within 7 to 10 working days.

faqs.q: How long do I have to file a card chargeback in Bangladesh?
faqs.a: Most Visa, Mastercard, and UnionPay issuing banks allow dispute chargeback claims within 60 to 120 calendar days from the original transaction date or the merchant’s promised delivery date. Submit your invoice, chat screenshots, and courier tracking failure to your bank immediately once the delivery window expires.

faqs.q: What if the Facebook page has no office address and used a personal bKash number?
faqs.a: Immediately call the bKash or Nagad customer fraud helpline with the exact Transaction ID to flag the account, file a formal General Diary at your local police station attaching screenshots and phone numbers, and report the page URL and digital trail to the CID Cyber Police Center.

faqs.q: Is an electronic invoice and WhatsApp chat valid proof in Bangladesh courts?
faqs.a: Yes. Following modern digital evidence provisions under the Evidence Act 1872 (Sections 65A and 65B), preserved PDF invoices, bank payment gateway logs, SMS confirmation alerts, and unaltered WhatsApp or Messenger transcripts are admissible electronic evidence in both DNCRP hearings and civil or criminal courts.
